_comment: Remote feature flags read by the app at launch, published as meta.flags. A flag here overrides the app's built-in default for every build that understands it, so it doubles as a kill switch: set a flag to false to turn a shipped feature off for everyone without an App Store release. Removing a flag restores the app's built-in behaviour on the next launch. A user who picks On/Off in the app's debug menu keeps their own setting either way.
_note_collectionSetup: Enabled for 2.4.2, whose build default is off outside TestFlight. Versions before 2.4.2 have no flag support and ignore this entirely. Set to false to disable guided collection setup for everyone.
